name: phased-code-review
title_zh: 断点续审的千文件代码库深挖器
tagline_zh: 几万行代码、跨服务调用、并发与泄漏，它分阶段审完还能续上——token 断了也不丢已查过的线索。
tagline_en: Multi-phase review that survives token limits: cross-file bugs, concurrency, leaks, lifecycle. Pick up where you.
desc_en: Systematic, resumable, multi-phase deep review of a large or multi-component codebase (thousands of files; Windows services, RPC/IPC, daemons, libraries, external integrations) to dig out technical, logical, security, concurrency, lifecycle, resource-leak and cross-file bugs — engineered so token/session limits never lose progress. Use when the user wants to audit or review an entire codebase or a
why_zh: 把审查拆成可恢复的多阶段流水线，每阶段产出物落盘，token 耗尽后从断点接着跑，不重审已查文件。
why_en: Checkpointed pipeline persists per-phase findings; resume mid-way after context exhaustion. Built for monorepos where.
limit_zh: 只认代码库整体审查，不处理单文件或小改动；需要能跑构建/静态分析的环境；不生成修复补丁，只输出问题清单与证据链。
limit_en: Whole-codebase audits only; needs build/static-analysis env; outputs issue reports with evidence, not patches. Not for single-file diffs.
title_en: Resumable deep codebase auditor for thousands of files
